:::: {.todaybox}

2. The question underneath – one paper, five analysts, and what they were each asking

This is the complete deck, with the four optional runs – the tools slides, the R tutorial, the methodological tutorial and the multiverse tutorial – in the main flow rather than behind the d key. It is the deck that the semester track and the self-study track read from, and the one that every shorter delivery is cut from. A single day cannot walk all of it; the one-day decks are the versions that can.
